description: A saved App Store or Google Play top chart for a country and day, from 2026-11-06.

category.description: Category slug as in pastcharts.com chart URLs. Default all, the overall chart.

chart.description: Top free, top paid or top grossing.

country.description: Two-letter country code in lower case, such as us or gb.

date.description: Day in YYYY-MM-DD. Leave out for the latest saved day.

limit.description: How many rows to return, 1 to 200. Default 25.

name: get_chart
title: Top chart for a day
